newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH POSTIPANKKI REPEATS SEES LOWER 97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH POSTIPANKKI REPEATS SEES LOWER 97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish state-owned banking group Postpankki Oy -- reporting a 196 million markka Q1 operating profit -- on Wednesday repeated it expected to make profits in coming months but full-year earnings would be below the 1996 level.
"Group earnings are expected to remain positive also in coming months, but the full-year result is estimated to be below last year's earnings," the bank said in its first-quarter report.
The Q1 operating profit fell from 355 million markka in the year-ago period. In 1996, Postipankki posted 602 million markka operating profit and a 480 million markka net profit.
